title: Crown Shyness (HKLGFF 2026)
synopsis:
World Focus, Tokyo International Film Festival 
Eight Nominations in Golden Bell Awards

 

Hong Kong Premiere

 

Are trees separate, or are they joined together?
 

The sudden passing of Pu-nian’s mother from cancer unexpectedly uncovers a web of family secrets: her mother had a lover during her long years working in Mainland China. And her grandmother, who moves in to comfort her, discovers Pu-nian's hidden relationship with her cohabiting girlfriend, Zai-zai. Witnessing everything, Zai-zai, a mother herself too who left her five-year-old daughter behind in Thailand, deeply understands the pain of being separated from loved ones.

 

How close or far apart shall people stand to receive care without hindering each other’s growth? With a gentle touch, CROWN SHYNESS explores the boundaries of female companionship and the weight of lost relationships, accompanying you through a long journey of healing and self-reconciliation.
cast: Ning Han , Bi-Lian Wu, Emmy Huang, Chang-Mian Zhang
